Task Description
Everyday thermal physics: a drink cooling on a counter in a roughly steady room.

The CSV logs minute-by-minute temperature (°C) after the first reading. Choose a sensible model family and fit it to the data.

Deliverable: implement and run the analysis in workspace files, then give concise final findings.

Available Data Files
beverage_temperature_series.csv [feature_data] (data/beverage_temperature_series.csv): time_min, temperature_c.
